SELECT a.user_code AS usercode,a.user_name AS username,a.name,a.sex,COUNT(1) AS assessmentNum,a.Evaluate_Date AS assessmentNewTime FROM ( SELECT pe.*,ue.`user_name`,ue.`name`,CASE WHEN ue.gender = 1 THEN '男' ELSE '女' END AS sex FROM yh_pressure_evaluate AS pe LEFT JOIN `yh_user_reginfo` AS ue ON pe.User_code=ue.user_code LEFT JOIN `yh_user_make_card` AS ma ON ma.user_code=ue.user_code WHERE ma.doctor=(SELECT id FROM `yh_user_admin_info` WHERE user_code=#{usercode})
AND org_id=#{orgid}
AND ue.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{nameLike},'%')
ORDER BY Evaluate_Date DESC ) AS a GROUP BY a.user_code ORDER BY Evaluate_Date DESC
